title: Potential resource leak
detail: The generator is closed in a finally block, but if an exception occurs before reaching this block, the generator may not be closed properly, leading to resource leaks.

title: Exception raised without context
detail: The RuntimeError is raised without providing context about why the generator didn't stop, which can make debugging difficult.

title: Missing check for statement start
detail: The condition `_continues_fmt_skip_line` now includes a check to ensure that the hidden code does not start a new statement. This prevents the crash when two consecutive statements are hidden by `# fmt: skip`.
